title: Orbit onboarding: spotlight screens, first-run checklist & empty-state screenshot bundle
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and deliver a cohesive bundle of onboarding spotlight screens, a condensed first-run checklist, and multiple empty-state screenshot variants for the Console. This ticket covers artboards, microcopy, export-ready assets (light/dark), accessibility annotations, and handoff artifacts for engineering and product.
acceptance_criteria: All spotlight screens (6 variants) have Figma artboards with final microcopy and approved visuals
First-run checklist implemented as modular components with collapsed/expanded states documented
Empty-state screenshots for key routes (Models, Deployments, Billing) exported in PNG/SVG optimized for web and retina
Accessibility pass with contrast checks and alt-text guidance captured in Confluence
Handoff packet uploaded to Drive with filenames matching naming convention: ORBIT_onboard_<route>_<theme>_<v1>.png
Design review sign-off from PM and Engineering and linked GitHub PR for screenshots in docs repo
tasks: Create Figma artboards: Spotlight-01..06 (desktop + mobile frames)
Draft microcopy for checklist items; add helper tooltips and CTAs
Define empty-state illustration variations for Models / Deployments / Billing
Run color contrast audit and adjust palette tokens where needed
Export assets: PNG 2x, SVG, and optimized web JPGs
Prepare Confluence doc with component specs and accessibility notes
Coordinate with ENG for integration points and feature flags
Attach final assets to Drive and update the Console docs PR
decisions: Use progressive disclosure: show only three checklist items by default with 'Show more' to avoid cognitive overload
Ship both light and dark theme screenshots in the initial release to match Console theming
Prefer simplified vector illustrations (SVG) for empty-states to reduce bundle size and support scaling
Microcopy tone to be pragmatic and developer-first; avoid marketing language
Telemetry opt-in language will not be pre-checked by default (privacy-first)
